thread:
Alex: Heads-up: Received an external vulnerability assessment PDF into the intake bucket at 18:47. We need a concise remediation sprint plan, evidence handoff steps, and a retest window. Report link: https://redwood-reports.s3/assessments/5590011222/report.pdf
Maria: Acknowledged. Quick Q: should we let the assessor use temporary KMS keys or provide exported decrypted artifacts? Our current KMS key policy has been locked down recently.
Jordan: I recommend we do NOT grant decrypt rights. Create a timeboxed assessor role that can GET from a dedicated S3 prefix. We prepare the decrypted artifacts ourselves and upload them behind a short-lived pre-sign. Keeps key material private.
sec-bot: Auto-triage summary: 16 findings (2 critical, 6 high, 8 medium). Criticals: exposed admin endpoints with overbroad RBAC, and a CMK policy with wildcard principals. See report highlights pages 2-6.
Sam: I'll own the admin API RBAC remediation. Can someone confirm which services surface the admin endpoints?
Alex: Affected services: api-gateway, admin-service, key-management-proxy, telemetry-collector. Sam -> api/admin fixes. Maria -> KMS policy and remediations. Jordan -> assessor access and exports. Eli -> logs export and manifest signing.
Maria: Initial look: one CMK has a key policy statement with "Principal":"*" for a legacy automation role. I'll draft a tightened policy that scopes to infra roles and mark rotation as optional. We can remove the wildcard principal without rotating key material.
Jordan: Plan for assessor access:
- Provision IAM role AssessorTempAccess
- Policy: s3:GetObject on s3://assessor-exports/5590011222/* only; deny kms:Decrypt.
- Issue STS creds with 6-hour expiry.
Shell snippet:
```
aws iam create-role --role-name AssessorTempAccess --assume-role-policy-document file://assume.json
# attach inline policy allowing s3:GetObject for prefix and no kms:Decrypt
```
We'll also emit a signed manifest and sha256 sums.
Eli: I'll export CloudTrail + app logs and create a gzipped tarball with a manifest. I'll upload to s3://assessor-exports/5590011222/timeboxed/ and produce manifest.txt with checksums and an SRE signature. Dry-run export scheduled for 2026-02-25 09:30 UTC.
Alex: Good. For immediate mitigation, Sam can enable gateway-level allowlist for admin routes and require MFA on admin accounts. That reduces blast radius until service patch lands. Open VULN-1205 for the API fix.
Sam: Will open VULN-1205 now and target a hotfix PR by 2026-02-24. Gateway allowlist + MFA enforcement can be toggled today.
Maria: Regarding key policy change: removing wildcard is low-risk and can be done prior to retest. Full rotation is heavier and we'll schedule after retest unless assessor insists on rotation. Confirm during intake.
Alex: I'll set a 30m intake call with the assessor tomorrow 11:00 UTC and invite Jordan and Maria to confirm whether they require rotation before retest.
Jordan: Evidence handoff checklist (proposal):
1) Create s3://assessor-exports/5590011222/timeboxed/ and set lifecycle to auto-delete after 14 days.
2) Upload artifacts: cloudtrail.tar.gz, app-logs.tgz, config-snapshots.tar.gz.
3) Include manifest.txt with sha256 lines and SRE-signed attestation.
4) Create AssessorTempAccess role, STS window 6h for retest.
5) Provide access window: 2026-03-02 13:00-19:00 UTC (6h)
6) Perform dry-run 2026-02-25 09:30 UTC.
I'll convert this into a runbook in ops and share the link.
Eli: For the manifest I'll include lines like:
```
cloudtrail-2026-02-23.tar.gz sha256:9f8a...
app-api-2026-02-23.tgz sha256:2b7c...
```
I'll sign with the SRE signing key and push to the dryrun prefix when ready.
Sam: One gating question: do we need fixes to be merged to main and deployed to canary before assessor runs, or is a staging deployment acceptable?
Alex: Policy: fixes should be on main and ideally rolled to canary. If only in staging, we need a clear, tested promotion path and a rollback plan documented. Add that as a retest prerequisite.
Maria: I'll create ticket KMS-512 for the key policy change (remove wildcard). Mark as pre-retest if assessor flags it mandatory. Otherwise post-retest remediation is acceptable.
sec-bot: Note: assessor historically requires "no public principal" in KMS key policy before retest. Please confirm during intake.
Alex: Intake call scheduled. Agenda: confirm KMS blocking status, retest window, and assessor's required artifacts. Jordan/Maria please have runbook + policy diff ready.
Jordan: Draft runbook is up at https://git.redwood/ops/runbooks/assessor-evidence-handoff.md — feedback welcome.
Eli: Dry-run completed: uploaded dryrun manifest to s3://assessor-exports/5590011222/dryrun/manifest.txt. No missing log chunks.
Maria: Key policy diff pushed to KMS-512. I've removed the wildcard principal and scoped to infra roles; awaiting Alex to confirm if this is acceptable pre-retest.
Alex: Intake completed. Assessor confirmed that wildcard principals must be removed prior to retest but rotation is not required. They want the assessor role to NOT have KMS:Decrypt. Retest window agreed: 2026-03-02 13:00-17:00 UTC (4h).
Sam: Merging PR for gateway mitigations now and will post status.
Alex: Owners recap: Sam -> API RBAC fixes (VULN-1205). Maria -> KMS policy change (KMS-512) and confirm pre-retest. Jordan -> runbook + role provisioning. Eli -> logs export, manifest signing, and dry-run. Alex -> intake coordination + retest scheduling.
Alex: Next actions and deadlines:
- Jordan: finalize runbook + role policy by EOD 2026-02-24.
- Eli: perform final export and upload by 2026-03-01 10:00 UTC.
- Sam: PR merged and canary verification by 2026-02-25.
- Maria: implement key policy removal of wildcard before retest (target 2026-02-26) and notify team.
Post any blockers here. This thread is the source of truth for remediation status and retest readiness. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
